comment: Compiles both electron-tier test suites to `dist/` for a real VS Code to run: the host-integration Mocha suites (`src/test-integration/**`, launched by `@vscode/test-cli`) and the ExTester E2E suites + page objects (`src/test-e2e/**`, launched by `extest`). Both runners load compiled JS, not Vitest-transformed TS. The Vitest `src` globs never collect either directory, so they stay out of `npm test`.
